verdict.rationale: Unreal documents in-editor testing of the loaded Level for testing and debugging. It also documents command-line launch options for testing specific maps and an automation tool for testing builds, which gives a local test loop separate from shipped builds. None of the evidence describes an isolated sandbox environment or guarantees that testing leaves production or live data untouched. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging isolation from production data, documentation of non-destructive test worlds, agent-oriented sandbox access, independent corroboration.
